title: The Nest Among the Stars
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders, and tonight the whole lesson turns on one quiet moment of noticing: a girl sees her cousin’s sad face, feels something turn inside, and slides her tallest tower to the middle before pride can grow.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because a quiet, thinking heart can notice pride before it grows. In Wren’s world today: Wren built the tallest block tower and told her cousin he could not touch it. Then she saw his sad face and felt something turn inside her. She scooted the whole tower to the middle. Just like Obadiah warned the proud people, Wren learned that being close is better than being high.
